content: Hi, I'm James, a Senior Software Engineer based around Birmingham.

I'm currently on the lookout for remote opportunities as a Senior Software Engineer. With almost 15 years of commercial web development experience and over 5 years building cross-platform mobile applications, I bring a deep understanding of software development to any team.

Over the past three years, I delivered and operated multiple large scale production services over GCP and AWS, working in an awesome team of engineers, using XP practices and pairing remotely every day to deliver high quality, robust features on time.

As web development has evolved, so have I. I started with front-end web development in the early 2000s, then picked up Java in my education, eventually bringing it into my first commercial role. After that, I moved over to .NET and C#, and picked up Node in the 2010s. I've worked on loads of platforms, frameworks, and languages, some everyday, some weird and wonderful.

Front end development has always been a passion of mine. I started learning HTML and CSS in my youth when I took an interest in how websites were made. I handled multiple redesign and rebrand projects for my employers, and I have kept fresh with design changes as the web has evolved.

In the 2010s I picked up mobile development, and have been building web and mobile apps since. All the while I was involved in the back-end, data analysis and infrastructure of the services to drive forward delivery without bottlenecks.

Over the last few years, I've helped adoption of AI tooling. I have delivered multiple talks on risks and their mitigation, tooling and best practices to make the tooling approachable to my peers. The landscape changes rapidly, and I enjoy keeping up to date with the latest developments, understanding how stuff works, and helping others gain the benefits of my experience.

I'd be a strong addition to any dev team looking for a seasoned, pragmatic engineer who can hit the ground running. I thrive on delivering high quality software with a solid understanding of development, and the skills required to deliver it, not just on my own, but with the team and business around me.
Thanks for taking the time to check out my CV, please get in touch if you're interested in working with me.
notSeekingContent: Hey, I'm James, a Senior Software Engineer based in The Midlands.
I've been tinkering with code since I was 12 years old, and I'm grateful to have turned my passion into an awesome career.

As a developer, I'm always up for a challenge and love tackling complex problems head-on. I specialize in full stack JavaScript development and have experience with Node.JS, React, Tailwind, C#, and many other languages.

I've worked on numerous applications across different sectors and have picked up a wealth of knowledge and experience along the way. I love working with all sorts of programming languages. I've worked on loads of applications across different sectors, and I've learned a ton along the way.
When I'm not coding, I like to skate, game, or just hang out with my family. My partner and kids mean the world to me. There's nothing better than spending quality time with the people you love most.

But enough about me - I'd love to learn more about you and your project. If you're looking for a seasoned developer who's got the skills and passion to bring your ideas to life, then let's connect and see what we can create together.
